art_direction: Swiss-grid precision with data-instrument aesthetic. The UI acts as a scientific measurement tool (Pragmr) for project delivery. Heavy emphasis on 1px borders, rigid grid structures, wide padding, mono-spaced data points, and strict typography.

headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter). Avoid default bold; prioritize extreme weight contrasts.

monospace.usage: For overlines, manifest numbers (01, 02), data points, metrics, and technical labels. Uppercase + tracking-widest for overlines.

colors.rules: Swiss Brutalist (Archetype 4). Color is function only. 95% of UI is monochrome. Use accent strictly to guide action or indicate delivery confidence status.

grids.framework: 12-column Swiss structural grid. Exposed grid lines.
grids.layout_rules: Use border-collapse techniques. Apply 1px border-r and border-b to grid items to expose the skeleton. Always use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout grids, not Shadcn layout cards.
grids.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32. Containers must pad content to avoid collision with the exposed borders.

layouts.hero: Large kinetic hero, masked line-by-line reveal. Right side: heavily stylized code/dashboard mockup of Delivery Confidence gauge.
layouts.bento_boxes: Grid Borders ('Technical Look'). Exposed skeletons. Asymmetrical spans (col-span-8, col-span-4).
layouts.section_headers: Numbered manifesto style (e.g., [ 01 ] THE PROBLEM) aligned to the left of the grid. Data-instrument style.

effects.scroll: Parallax on background structural lines. Use framer-motion for scroll reveals.
effects.marquees: One slow editorial marquee (react-fast-marquee) for Trust/Proof section.
effects.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons/links. Avoid layout shifts.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture overlay on the background to kill the 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.components: Custom stylized cursors (optional). Delivery Confidence gauges must feel like precision instruments, not generic radial charts. Use clipped frames and spotlight effects.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast standards. Normal text min 4.5:1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.strategy: High-contrast photography, placed in rigid containers. Imagery is purely functional.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for smooth 2D orchestration and parallax. 3D is not mandatory, but if adding a spotlight to the hero gauge, use CSS radial-gradients or framer-motion 3D transform for a subtle 2.5D tilt effect.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js to include Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, and IBM Plex Mono as font families.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling at the root of the app.
For the 12 sections, wrap them in a master container with `max-w-7xl mx-auto`. Use `border-l border-r border-zinc-200` to create the outer boundary of the Swiss grid.
Create the 'Delivery Confidence' gauge mockups using purely functional, stylized HTML/CSS (data-instrument look: thin arcs, mono text, strict spacing).
Forms MUST use Shadcn UI customized to remove generic rounded corners (use sharp edges, `rounded-none`).
Include lead capture saving to backend with email notification placeholder or basic implementation.
Never use generic centered layouts. Opt for tension-creating asymmetry.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where necessary, but for this specific Swiss design, lean heavily on solid colors and 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles (for this design, use sharp rectangular buttons with intense hover states).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
